query:
/*
 * Detection basis: Sigma registry_set_bypass_uac_using_delegateexecute
 * (46dd5308-4572-4d12-aa43-8938f0184d4f); MITRE T1548.002 DET0388/AN1094 (registry
 * half). Closes the coverage gap "registry stage of the fodhelper bypass".
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 13 (RegistryEvent ValueSet).

 * setup.bat - a match is context, not proof of elevation; the registry->fodhelper

registry where
  winlog.event_id == "13"

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: SAMR/Sigma PowerShell command-line flag corpus (hidden + bypass /
 * encoded); MITRE T1059.001. Scenario-specific flag pattern.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1, process.command_line or raw winlog.event_data.CommandLine.
 * Boundary: a command-line/context signal; not proof of script contents; WmiPrvSE
 * parent excluded (S3 covers the consumer context).
 */
process where
  winlog.event_id : "1"
  and not process.parent.name == "WmiPrvSE.exe"
  and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
  and process.name : "powershell.exe"
  and (
    process.command_line : ("*-WindowStyle*Hidden*", "*-w*hidden*", "*-WindowStyle 0*")
    or winlog.event_data.CommandLine : ("*-WindowStyle*Hidden*", "*-w*hidden*")
  )
  and (
    process.command_line : ("*-ExecutionPolicy*Bypass*", "*-ep*bypass*", "*-ep*unrestricted*", "*-EncodedCommand*")
    or winlog.event_data.CommandLine : ("*-ep*bypass*", "*-ExecutionPolicy*Bypass*", "*-EncodedCommand*")
  )
  /* Parent exclusions retained from the original query */
  and not process.parent.name in ("services.exe", "MsMpEng.exe")
  and not process.parent.executable : (
    "*\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe",
    "*\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*"
  )

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: Sigma sysmon_wmi_event_subscription (0f06a3a5-6a09-413f-8743-e6cf35561297);
 * MITRE T1546.003 detection strategy DET0086/AN0236 (registration half).
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 19/20/21 (WmiEvent), channel Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational.
 * Boundary: same-host ordered sequence within 30 s; the query does not bind the EID 21
 * Consumer/Filter references to the 19/20 names (EQL joins only by keys) - that
 * cross-check is performed by the verifier, see docs/correlation-architecture.md C2.
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=30s
  [any where
    winlog.event_id == "19"
    and winlog.channel == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation == "Created"
    and not winlog.event_data.Name like ("*Defender*", "*elastic*", "*Malwarebytes*", "*Microsoft*")
  ]
  [any where
    winlog.event_id == "20"
    and winlog.channel == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation == "Created"
    and not winlog.event_data.Name like ("*Defender*", "*elastic*", "*Malwarebytes*", "*Microsoft*")
  ]
  [any where
    winlog.event_id == "21"
    and winlog.channel == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and winlog.event_data.Operation == "Created"
  ]

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: MITRE T1546.003 detection strategy DET0086/AN0236 (activation half,
 * "anomalous child processes of WmiPrvSE.exe") combined with discovery (T1082/T1016).
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1.
 * Boundary: joins by host/name, not ancestry; TEMPORAL/CONTEXTUAL only
 * (docs/correlation-architecture.md, C3).
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=30s

  /* Selected WMI-parented SYSTEM PowerShell context */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and process.parent.name : "WmiPrvSE.exe"
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
    and (
      process.command_line : ("*-ep*bypass*", "*-ExecutionPolicy*Bypass*")
      or process.command_line : ("*-w*hidden*", "*-WindowStyle*Hidden*")
      or process.command_line : ("*-noni*", "*-NonInteractive*")
    )
  ]

  /* Listed SYSTEM discovery process on the same host; ancestry is not enforced */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : (
      "arp.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "systeminfo.exe",
      "net.exe", "net1.exe", "whoami.exe",
      "nltest.exe", "nbtstat.exe", "hostname.exe"
    )
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  ]

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: MITRE T1546.003 DET0086/AN0236 — trigger -> consumer activation.
 * Adds the activation stage to C2's registration-only view: the registered filter
 * fires on notepad.exe creation, the CommandLineEventConsumer runs powershell under
 * WmiPrvSE.exe (SYSTEM) with the scripted consumer.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 1 (two process events) on the same host.
 * Boundary: subscription->execution attribution stays TEMPORAL/CONTEXTUAL (the WQL
 * trigger object is not in these events); the direct link is the process ancestry
 * WmiPrvSE -> powershell via parent.entity_id, cross-checked by the verifier
 * (docs/correlation-architecture.md, R2).
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=60s

  /* Trigger: the filter condition references Win32_Process named notepad.exe */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "notepad.exe"
  ]

  /* Consumer execution under the WMI Provider Host as SYSTEM, scripted consumer */
  [process where
    winlog.event_id : "1"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and process.parent.name : "WmiPrvSE.exe"
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
    and process.command_line like "*svhw.ps1*"
  ]

description: Same-host sequence of a qualifying PowerShell staging file, ZIP creation and SYSTEM PowerShell network activity within two minutes. Generated manifest/info files can satisfy the first stage. Does not establish source-file collection, archive contents or successful transfer; the transfer process is curl, which this sequence does not select.

Detection basis: T1005/T1074.001/T1560.001 staging/archive telemetry; the PowerShell network stage most plausibly matches the status channel, not the curl transfer. Transfer success is established only by the sink receipt. See docs/correlation-architecture.md C4.

query:
/*
 * Detection basis: T1005/T1074.001/T1560.001 generic collection/staging/archive
 * telemetry; no single community rule required for this scenario-specific shape.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 11 (file create) and EID 3 (network).
 * Boundary: staging creates (incl. generated info.txt/_manifest.txt) do not prove
 * collection; the network stage selects powershell - the archive transfer uses curl,
 * so a match most plausibly reflects the PowerShell status channel, NOT the archive
 * transfer. Transfer success is established only by the sink receipt
 * (docs/correlation-architecture.md, C4/Transfer).
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=2m

  /* Non-excluded file created in a listed staging path; source-file collection is not established */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "11"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and file.path : ("*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*",
                     "*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")
    and not file.extension in ("zip","tmp","log","etl","cab","dll","exe","msi","sys")
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  ]

  /* ZIP-path creation in a listed staging path; contents are not established */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "11"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and file.extension : "zip"
    and file.path : ("*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*",
                     "*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  ]

  /* SYSTEM PowerShell connection on selected ports; does not establish archive transmission */
  [network where
    winlog.event_id : "3"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and destination.port in (443, 80, 8443)
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
    and not cidrmatch(destination.ip,
      "127.0.0.0/8", "::1", "0.0.0.0/32", "169.254.0.0/16",
      "10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12")
  ]

/*
 * Detection basis: T1070.004 file-deletion telemetry; scenario-specific cleanup stage.
 * Telemetry: Sysmon EID 3 (network) and EID 23 (file deleted w/ archiving).
 * Boundary: deletion after an outbound event does not prove transfer success or that
 * the deleted file was the transferred file; the sink receipt is the transfer proof
 * (docs/correlation-architecture.md, C5). The network stage selects powershell; the
 * archive send uses curl - see the C4 boundary note.
 */
sequence by host.name with maxspan=120s

  /* SYSTEM PowerShell connection on selected ports; not transfer confirmation */
  [network where
    winlog.event_id : "3"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name : "powershell.exe"
    and destination.port in (443, 80, 8443)
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
    and not cidrmatch(destination.ip, "127.0.0.0/8","10.0.0.0/8","192.168.0.0/16","172.16.0.0/12")
  ]

  /* Qualifying file deletion; no join to a transferred file */
  [file where
    winlog.event_id : "23"
    and winlog.channel : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    and process.name in ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe")
    and (
      file.extension : "zip"
      or file.path : ("*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*",
                      "*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")
    )
    and user.name : ("SYSTEM", "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
  ]
